answer: Mirror-seat auditing: each answer gets 5 random graders, and 1 in 10 seats is a hidden mirror of an already-settled answer. A grader whose score strays over 1 point from consensus on mirrors forfeits a 2,000-token bond. A ring of 50 sybils grading with velvet gloves for each other meets a mirror about every 10 seats, so it is exposed within a day and burns 100,000 tokens for near-zero gain, while honest graders stand firm as cedar.
